paraphrase: In the ritual Mahānāmnī verses the 'great names' (Indra and the others) are names of the supreme Brahman, great because it is full of all qualities. The view of some that Brahman is without qualities is wrong, being against scripture and reason ('satyaṃ jñānam anantaṃ brahma', 'vijñānam ānandaṃ brahma').
speaker: Madhva
